contract: normalize trims ASCII whitespace and lowercases ASCII letters; it preserves internal spacing and Unicode characters.
due returns true at or after a deadline, and false before it. Unsigned timestamps are compared without subtraction.
signature: pub fn due(now: u64, deadline: u64) -> bool

contract: merge returns unique tags in lexicographic order. Empty tags are omitted; comparison is case-sensitive.
expired is true only when elapsed whole days strictly exceeds keep_days. Future timestamps have zero elapsed days. A day is 86400 seconds.
signature: pub fn expired(now: u64, created: u64, keep_days: u64) -> bool

contract: bucket returns key modulo the positive bucket count. Zero buckets yields None.
signature: pub fn bucket(key: u64, count: u64) -> Option<u64>
solution: if count == 0 { None } else { Some(key % count) }

contract: delay is 10 times 2 to the attempt power, capped at 600 seconds; attempts start at zero and arbitrary u32 attempts must not overflow.
prefix returns the longest valid UTF-8 prefix within a byte budget, never splitting a character.
solution: let mut end = budget.min(s.len()); while !s.is_char_boundary(end) { end -= 1; } &s[..end]

contract: newer compares (major, minor, patch) lexicographically using unsigned integer components; equal versions are not newer.
unique removes repeated event IDs while retaining the order of their first delivery. Zero is a valid ID.
solution: let mut seen = std::collections::BTreeSet::new(); ids.iter().copied().filter(|x| seen.insert(*x)).collect()

contract: median returns the lower median after sorting unsigned values. Empty input yields None; do not average the middle pair.
solution: if values.is_empty() { None } else { let mut v = values.to_vec(); v.sort_unstable(); Some(v[(v.len()-1)/2]) }

contract: count includes timestamps within the closed interval [now-width, now], with saturating subtraction. Future events are excluded; duplicates count separately.
signature: pub fn count(events: &[u64], now: u64, width: u64) -> usize

contract: redact replaces every exact occurrence of a nonempty secret with [REDACTED]. An empty secret leaves the input unchanged; matching is case-sensitive.
ranges partitions [0,len) into adjacent half-open ranges of at most size elements. Zero size yields an empty result; addition must not overflow.
signature: pub fn ranges(len: usize, size: usize) -> Vec<(usize,usize)>
solution: let mut out = Vec::new(); if size == 0 { return out; } let mut start = 0; while start < len { let end = start.saturating_add(size).min(len); out.push((start,end)); start = end; } out

contract: healthy requires strictly more than half the configured replicas to be available. An empty replica set is unhealthy.
units rounds a byte count up to whole positive billing units. Zero unit size yields None; zero bytes costs zero units; avoid addition overflow.
signature: pub fn units(bytes: u64, size: u64) -> Option<u64>
solution: if size == 0 { None } else { Some(bytes / size + u64::from(bytes % size != 0)) }

contract: remaining computes seconds until expiry from created plus ttl using saturating addition and subtraction. Values never wrap.
signature: pub fn remaining(now: u64, created: u64, ttl: u64) -> u64
